wiki_article: This gw.tachyon continuity tether closes a three-day Capture Registry session on chain 9271269a, following #1544 and #1567. It records three captures seated, the registered forecast EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 carried to v0.3, and a two-by-two model of the cleanse: addresses with high deposit mass hold unless an institutional neighbour exists to displace them into, so vulnerability is a matter of nomination rather than volume. Its main finding is a convergence. A findings section written for another instance carried six wrong figures and one quotation that occurs nowhere in the corpus, all produced by one instrument that scored keyword presence and reported it as entity resolution. The operator had disclosed that the Provenance Erasure Rate is likewise designed to score naming. The seated Bing Copilot capture at operational semiotics, which names the archive fully while losing the entity, breaks both measures on the same axis. The tether names the session's single failure mode — reading the field that describes the thing instead of the thing — and files itself as an exemplar of the Obelus Principle rather than as an apology.
